summary: PLAY05: added one prominent '眼前这一步' current-objective card to the supermarket night board in backstage-ui.js, shown only when marketInfo().enabled, zone is market and run active, in both manual and automatic modes. The card is derived read-only from real marketInfo/run/auto state: undecided walk-to-counter vs at-counter choice; trade fetch-barrel (real 3-slot capacity, distinguishes the deliverable rolling barrel from street empty barrels, never mentions R delivery); barrel-in-bag return using canDeliver/reasons; delivered extraction (next-day receipt only after safe extraction on nights 1/2; night 3 no cashable receipt; no cash granted, no repeat-delivery prompt); salvage destinations (real shelf/cold item states; blackout keeps free shelf choice distinct from the EUR5 fuse part; confirms goods in bag and safe return). Auto mode maps active goals to truthful legs (正在前往 titles/controls/A.view choices untouched); capacity/stuck/glimpse events override advice and blocked states never announce delivery. In the market the manual board hides the unrelated Noor/parcel/greenhouse objectives block; outside-market and legacy runs render byte-identical old boards. All risk/cost prose, buttons/disabled reasons, location panel, capacity, live message and pause behavior preserved; no new CSS or mechanics. Signature gained real keys (load, item0-3 states, item2 in bag) so stages refresh after genuine transitions without tests forcing ui.signature; render mutates nothing. New suite test-market-focus-ui.js (11 real-behavior tests, VM harness, real B/A commands and movement) observed RED against unwired UI (9/11 failed 'focus card exists'; legacy/no-mutation tests already passed), then GREEN 11/11. Old 32/32 stay green.
